implementation.prisma_suggestion: Add closedVenues table or Venue.status = CLOSED with closedAt date. In url_ingest adapter, check venueName against blacklist case-insensitive, if match -> skip ingest and log.
implementation.sql_example: CREATE TABLE "ClosedVenue" ("venueName" TEXT PRIMARY KEY, "closedAt" DATE, "reason" TEXT, "action" TEXT);
zaylist_specific: Add to QSearch: never return events for these venueNames
Add to Directory Places: set status CLOSED, hide from discovery, keep historical events
In cleanup script: delete any LIVE events where venueName IN blacklist and dateStart > closedAt
